title: The Helium Philharmonic
crime_description: The opera house pipe organ was pumped full of helium gas right before the opening crescendo of Don Giovanni.

suspect.name: Camille 'Cacophony' Cartwright
suspect.quirk: Speaks in over-the-top musical metaphors, using opera terms to describe everyday situations.

dossier.text: Security footage shows a figure entering the organ room at 10:15 PM, wearing a black cloak with a silver pin in the shape of a treble clef.
The pipe organ's gas tank was filled with helium between 10:30 PM and 10:45 PM, as recorded by the opera house's maintenance log.
Witnesses report seeing a person matching Cartwright's description fleeing the scene, dropping a torn piece of fabric caught on a nearby music stand at 11:15 PM.

truth_timeline.event: Cartwright sneaks into the organ room, wearing the black cloak and treble clef pin.
Cartwright executes the micro-crime, pumping the helium into the pipe organ.
Cartwright flees, accidentally dropping the torn fabric.

lie_plan.cover_story: I was merely there to adjust the harmonium's resonance, but I must have gotten my cloak caught on something. I swear I didn't do anything to the pipe organ.

weak_points.claim: I didn't enter the organ room until after 11:00 PM, to fix a minor tuning issue.
weak_points.planned_slip: Oh, I'm sure the staff would remember if I was already there, what with the late-night harmonium adjustments and all.

weak_points.claim: The gas tank was already filled with helium when I arrived, I must have thought it was just air.
weak_points.planned_slip: I could have sworn it said 'helium' on the tank, but it must have been just a fancy label.

weak_points.claim: I wasn't fleeing, I was just taking a shortcut to the dressing rooms to change into my street clothes.
weak_points.planned_slip: I'm sure the witnesses just saw me in a hurry, not making a mad dash for it.

solution_contradictions: Cartwright claimed to have entered the organ room after 11:00 PM, directly conflicting with fact-1's timestamp.
Cartwright claimed the gas tank was already filled with helium, which contradicts fact-2's maintenance log record.
